items.title: Disciplinary Policy and Procedures — Updated
items.body: The Southwest Division's Disciplinary Policy and Procedures has been amended, effective August 3, 2026. It applies to any claim, complaint, report or investigation opened on or after that date; anything reported earlier stays under the previous policy. Read the full document on the Policies and Procedures page.
